review_summary: 8 accepted, 11 rejected out of 19. verify-snippet: 19/19 FOUND on the first run. Every page was re-read with scripts/peek-page.ts (no robots.txt refusals). All 4 tuition rows are 2026-27 rates for Fall 2027 entrants and are rejected under the existing CMU / U of T / TUM wrong-year rule. All 5 living-cost rows are rejected: 3 understate the money needed (food and housing only, or below the university's own budget), 3 are fall + spring (about 9-month) budgets stored as 'year' or 'semester' (the app counts 12 and 6 months), and 4 are for an earlier year than the intake (rows can fail on more than one count). Imperial's 12-month £22,722 fails only on year (2026 prices for an Oct 2027 - Sep 2028 stay); a maintainer can accept it by policy. Accepted: 7 scholarship texts (none uses 'guarantee'/'automatic', so compare.ts never treats them as guarantees) and CMU duration 18 months with basis 'inferred' (shown as Likely). Merge effect: 8 empty program facts are filled; no conflicts, no overwrites (all target fields are null in data/programs.seed.json).

proposals.evidence_snippet: Most students will complete the program in three semesters, but if you’re switching to computer science from another field, you may need an additional semester to fill gaps in your undergraduate training.
proposals.notes: basis=inferred: three semesters converted at 6 months per semester (the same convention as src/lib/cost.ts and the accepted TUM '4 semesters = 24 months'). In calendar terms a Fall 2027 start finishing after the third semester is roughly August 2027 - December 2028. 'Most students': students switching from another field may need a fourth semester (24 months).

review.checks: verify-snippet --file data/proposals/raw/costs.json: 19/19 FOUND on the first run (no network errors). peek-page re-read https://csd.cmu.edu/academics/masters/ms-in-computer-science live on 2026-11-24: line 100 is the MSCS FAQ 'How long does the program take to complete?' answered 'Most students will complete the program in three semesters, but if you're switching to computer science from another field, you may need an additional semester...'. Official CMU CSD page, right programme (MSCS, not the Fifth Year M.S.). 18 = 3 semesters x 6 months, the convention moneyOverDuration uses for period 'semester' (src/lib/cost.ts) and the same semester-to-month reading as the accepted TUM/Wuerzburg '4 semesters = 24 months'; with it a per-academic-year fee totals to exactly 1.5 years = 3 semesters. basis 'inferred' is kept, so the app shows Likely, never Verified. A Fall 2027 start to the end of a third (fall) semester is about 16-17 calendar months, so 18 slightly overstates months of living (safe direction: more money, not less). The extra-semester case is for students switching from another field, not the target group (Pakistani BSCS graduates).
